clips.title: The story
paras: Zarrin teaches a lesson in balance through the Recipe of the Kaldorei. In Dolanaar, young cooks learn to gather only what they need from Teldrassil's woods.

Behind the inn in Dolanaar, Zarrin tends a bubbling cauldron and teaches young adventurers the traditions of his people. The night elves once called themselves the kaldorei, or children of the stars. Zarrin begins their understanding of that heritage with the bond between a hunter, their food, and Teldrassil's boughs, rather than the battlefield.

Zarrin teaches restraint through a simple demand: gather small spider legs from the woodland arachnids outside Shadowglen, but take exactly seven. The kaldorei seek harmony with nature by taking only what they need and showing kindness to the wild. Even in troubled times, that balance matters. A spider kabob becomes a lesson in living with care.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Long ago, the night elves were called the kaldorei, a name that means "children of the stars." Learning of the past is an important step in your path as an adventurer, friend, so listen well to what I have to tell you.

The kaldorei have always taken much pride in their harmonious relationship with nature. This means that we only take from nature what is necessary, and that we return in kind. This balance has afforded us much, friend.
Go out and collect seven small spider legs -- no more than that, and return to me.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Remember the balance, friend. I wish you to develop an understanding and a strong empathy for the living forests.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Always remember what I have shown you today, friend. You are part of the balance that the night elves strive to keep intact, even during troublesome times.
